ConfidentialitePage.description_metadata: CreditX privacy policy and processing of personal data.
ConfidentialitePage.layout_subtitle: CreditX Sàrl – processing of personal data (Swiss FADP + GDPR).
ConfidentialitePage.section1_desc: The controller responsible for processing personal data is:
ConfidentialitePage.section1_p2: CreditX is a platform operated by CreditX Sàrl, active both as a digital service provider and as an independent intermediary / broker.
ConfidentialitePage.s2_1_l2: Postal address (in particular for insurance and banking partners)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_1_l4: Phone (if needed to contact the client or for TAN / security verification)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_2_l3: Occupational pension (LPP/BVG) data (certificates, projected pensions, capital, gaps)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_2_l4: Data relating to 3rd-pillar solutions (existing or planned)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_2_note: This data is used exclusively for CreditX's pension analysis and to enable the preparation and comparison of personalised insurance offers or banking solutions.
ConfidentialitePage.s2_3_p: In connection with life insurance offers (insurance-based 3rd pillar), some companies may require health information (questionnaires, lifestyle details, etc.).
ConfidentialitePage.s2_3_l1: Processed solely to prepare offers or arrange a policy.
ConfidentialitePage.s2_3_l2: Automatically deleted as soon as the contract is signed.
ConfidentialitePage.s2_4_l1: Pension fund (LPP/BVG) certificates (scanned by our AI)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_4_l3: Identity documents (where applicable, for KYC compliance)
ConfidentialitePage.s2_4_note: Identity documents are deleted from our servers as soon as the contract is signed and in force with the partner.
ConfidentialitePage.s2_5_l2: Browsing data and app usage statistics
ConfidentialitePage.s2_5_note: Purposes: platform security, performance statistics and continuous improvement of the user experience.
ConfidentialitePage.s3_l1: Performance of a contract or implementation of pre-contractual measures.
ConfidentialitePage.s3_l2: Explicit consent (in particular for sensitive health data where required).
ConfidentialitePage.s3_l4: Legitimate interest (service improvement, fraud prevention and IT security).
ConfidentialitePage.s4_1_p: Only strictly necessary data is transmitted to our partner institutions, solely for the purpose of obtaining personalised offers and arranging a policy at your request.
ConfidentialitePage.s4_2_p: Access limited to what is strictly necessary ("need-to-know basis"), solely for technical support, advice and follow-up of subscription files.
ConfidentialitePage.s4_3_p: Transmission carried out only where required by Swiss law or following a decision of a competent authority.
ConfidentialitePage.s4_guarantee: Absolute guarantee: We never sell your personal data and under no circumstances share it with external marketing or advertising partners.
ConfidentialitePage.section5_p: We implement state-of-the-art technical and organisational measures (end-to-end encryption, secure hosting, regular audits) to protect your data against any unauthorised access, loss, alteration or accidental disclosure.
ConfidentialitePage.s6_v1: As long as the account is active (deletion on request)
ConfidentialitePage.section7_p1: In accordance with the Swiss FADP and the GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure ("right to be forgotten"), objection (in particular to processing for marketing purposes), and data portability.
ConfidentialitePage.section7_p2: To exercise your rights simply and quickly, contact our data protection officer via:
ConfidentialitePage.section8_p: This privacy policy may be updated at any time to reflect legal or technical developments. The version published on the site always prevails.
